Use case: ui-mockup / 3D product scene for a design-review prototype. Create ONE clean landscape 1536x1024 image, with dimensions exactly 3:2. Reference1 is the approved board MATERIAL AND OBJECT DESIGN, reference2 is the approved card detailing context. Reframe that exact luxury board into an extremely high overhead near-orthographic PLAYABLE VIEW, camera 75 degrees above tabletop. NO title, NO collage, NO inset, NO samples, NO interface text, NO graphic caption, NO border around the image.
Retain the exact ROYAL CLUB art direction in reference1: thick smoked walnut burl timber frame, deep emerald green felt/leather, narrow brushed warm brass inlays, parchment cream track cells, low three-place brass podium. Enamel anatomically realistic miniature horse sculptures. Warm polished private equestrian club.
Geometric layout is crucial so interactive HTML objects can be placed on this scene later: board is perfectly horizontally aligned, SYMMETRIC front-to-back with no yaw, edges parallel to image edges with only very subtle perspective, centered. Outer rectangular board frame from x=3% to97%, y=4% to97%. One continuous oval racing path occupies x=7% to93%, y=8% to69%, divided into generous cells around one single ring (not seven separate lanes). Single start finish checker stripe. No printed track numbers. Center infield occupied by only an understated low three-position podium in the far upper center (y30%) and a tiny blank ruled payout table left (x27%,y42%). Leave a generous clean EMPTY felt/board area in center-right x58%,y44% for an animated die; NO die in this image, NO raised icons. No trees or scenery covering cells. Exactly seven riderless realistic detailed miniature horse figures (white black pink blue yellow green orange) stand on seven consecutive near track spaces from x30% to75%, at around y60%, beautifully sculpted like the original.
MOST IMPORTANT BOTTOM CARD RAIL: inside the board along its near edge, below the oval, lay EXACTLY SEVEN equally spaced RECESSED rectangular card-and-chip bays in one perfectly horizontal row, bay centers x=11.6%,24.4%,37.2%,50%,62.8%,75.6%,88.4%. Each bay starts at y74%, ends y94%, total width 11.8% of canvas. Every bay is EMPTY, with a portrait CARD depression taking its left 68% and a tiny separate oval chip well on its right 25%. No cards, no card artwork, no numbers, no words in the depressions, no tokens in the wells; these will be interactive overlays. Card recess walls rich tactile material with narrow metal trim, one matching identity color band per bay left-to-right WHITE BLACK PINK BLUE YELLOW GREEN ORANGE. Strong but shallow realistic depth and ambient occlusion, complete board all visible. Board occupies almost all image with a slim neutral softly lit matching tabletop background margin. Beautiful product CGI, real tactility, museum quality quiet wealth, sharp surface detail, warm contact shadows. Do NOT reproduce poster layout. Do NOT generate UI or any textual labels.
